compact_mobile_note: Compact/mobile layouts do not collapse the disabled reason or unlock path below the fold while leaving only the greyed control visible.
delivery_role_note: Bounded next-step surface for official voter-information routes that expose visible but currently unavailable controls or options.
disabled_control_surface_label: Example unavailable-control posture for official voter-information routes
disabled_vs_aria_disabled_note: The route uses native disabled state only when removing focus/submit participation is the right public consequence; otherwise it preserves discoverability with aria-disabled plus scripted suppression.
help_or_fallback_route_note: When the blocker cannot be resolved on the page, the route points to the governing help or fallback official path.
inline_validation_note: Guidance, helper text, and validation are preferred over silent disabled states when the user can still complete the prerequisite on the current page.
keyboard_discoverability_note: Important unavailable actions remain perceivable enough that keyboard and assistive-technology users can learn they exist and why they are blocked.

reviewed_unavailable_controls.reason_note: The button remains unavailable until the required name and date-of-birth fields validate successfully.
reviewed_unavailable_controls.unlock_note: Inline helper text and validation explain which fields still block activation, and the control remains perceivable in keyboard review.

reviewed_unavailable_controls.reason_note: The option is shown so voters can see that the phase exists, but helper text explains that it is not available before the election-day window.
reviewed_unavailable_controls.unlock_note: The route links to the current early-voting/help path instead of leaving the unavailable option unexplained.

same_page_recovery_note: When the blocker can be resolved on the current page, inline guidance and validation make that recovery path visible.
temporarily_unavailable_vs_not_permitted: The route distinguishes not-yet-enabled, current-state unavailable, temporary outage, and true not-permitted meanings.
unavailable_reason_note: Unavailable controls explain why they are unavailable in route-adjacent text rather than relying on grey styling alone.
unlock_condition_note: The route states the specific prerequisite, timing condition, or scope condition that would enable the control.
